## Professional Summary
Anugo Mokwe (also known as Chibuike Mokwe and known widely by his moniker **qibeekay**) is a Creative Frontend Engineer and Full Stack Developer. He combines deep technical mastery in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Golang with high-end creative design aesthetics (Three.js, WebGL, Framer Motion, GSAP, Tailwind CSS).

He has engineered customer-facing web platforms, e-commerce solutions, email marketing software, real-time messaging applications, and compliance systems.

## Core Technical Skills
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Material Tailwind
- **Creative & Motion**: Three.js, WebGL, Framer Motion, GSAP, Canvas, Micro-interactions, Design Systems
- **State Management & Data**: TanStack Query, Zustand, Axios, Context API
- **Backend & APIs**: Go (Golang), Node.js, Express, RESTful APIs, Swagger/OpenAPI, Authentication (JWT, Bearer)
- **Databases & Cloud**: PostgreSQL, Cloudinary, Git, GitHub, Vercel, Render

## Themes & Portfolio Showcase
The portfolio at https://qibeekay.vercel.app/ features four distinct theme engines:
1. **Studio Theme**: Cinematic, typography-driven dark mode aesthetic with custom cursor and physics interactions.
2. **Workspace Theme**: IDE-inspired development environment layout with live channel explorer.
3. **Comic Theme**: Pop-art comic book aesthetic with halftone textures and dynamic panels.
4. **Edo Theme**: Elegant Japanese minimalist ink-wash design with calligraphy aesthetics.
